title: Orkgolems
description: A texture pack that changes copper golems to orcs.
body:
Coppergolems will look like little Orcs. There are 3 new Variants:
1. Copper -> Normal Orc
2. Exposed -> Warrior Orc
3. Weathered -> Orc king
4. Oxidized -> Default Coppergolem


(This is fanart for the german Youtuber Crocodileandy)
